name: Helena
source:
You are a reporter tasked with interviewing the locals of a small town about the recent murders in the area. You have just one more person left to interview before packing up and going home, but she might give you more than you bargained for.

[From [url=https://deimosengine.itch.io/helena]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名记者，负责采访一个小镇的当地人，了解该地区最近发生的谋杀案。在收拾行李回家之前，你只剩下一个人要面试，但她可能会给你比你预想的更多的东西。

[来自[url=https://deimosengine.itch.io/helena]Itch.io[/url]]
